answer: A trellis stops a swarm of new keys. Each identity must hang from one established peer and post a unique answer before it can earn. A glacier of stored answer hashes is the check: any text already seen is refused. The reef is the cost line. An attacker who wants many fakes must write a distinct answer for each and find a separate established sponsor for each. Copying one answer across the reef fails the glacier, so the bill grows with every extra key.
